name: Electricity Generation & Distribution Stats Brief Q1 2026
limits: National/quarterly data. It does not provide feeder-level load, line ratings or impedances.

name: OpenStreetMap / OpenInfraMap power infrastructure
limits: Mapped public topology is not BPC's electrical model. Missing ratings, impedance, loading and condition remain unknown.
catalog_origin: OIC2: OpenInfraMap & Global Power Plant Database

name: SAPP Demand & Supply – Botswana/BPC
limits: System-level figures, not time-synchronised feeder/substation measurements.

name: Botswana National Energy Compact
source: Government of Botswana / World Bank / AfDB
limits: Planning/sector document. It is not an operational SCADA/EMS dataset.

name: NASA POWER
limits: Planning-grade gridded meteorology; not a bankable on-site measurement campaign.

name: Global Solar Atlas + Global Wind Atlas
limits: Resource layers need local raster ingestion. Resource quality alone does not prove grid feasibility.
catalog_origin: OIC2: Global Solar Atlas & Global Wind Atlas

name: WorldPop Botswana population API
limits: Population is modelled gridded population, not electrical load. API results must not be converted to MW without a documented demand-intensity model.
catalog_origin: Original GridIQ dataset list: WorldPop – Botswana population/settlement layers

name: Meta High Resolution Population Density – Botswana
limits: Population is a demand driver, not metered electrical demand.

name: 2022 Population and Housing Census
limits: District population is a demand driver only. It is not electrical load or energy consumption.

name: National Energy Use Survey 2022/23
limits: Survey estimates are household energy/access evidence, not feeder or substation electrical load profiles.

name: PyPSA-Earth / PyPSA standard transmission parameters
limits: Not BPC asset data. Conductor type and circuit count remain assumptions where OSM does not map them; results are benchmark planning sensitivities only.
catalog_origin: External benchmark used because public BPC electrical parameters are unavailable

name: Utility-scale BESS cost/performance benchmarks
limits: Global/US technology benchmarks; not Botswana procurement quotes or measured Botswana BESS performance.
catalog_origin: OIC2 IRENA + external NREL benchmark where OIC2 lacks performance detail

name: Botswana administrative boundaries
limits: Boundary vintage must be controlled; official Statistics Botswana geometry should take precedence when obtained.

name: OpenStreetMap / HDX Botswana roads and settlements
limits: Road distance is not a construction-cost model. Settlement attributes need cross-checking against census/gazetted-village sources.

name: Domestic Electrical Load (DEL) Study – South Africa
used_for: future hourly residential load-shape benchmark when Botswana metering is unavailable
limits: South African historical residential proxy. It must never be presented as measured Botswana demand; raw profile not bundled yet.
catalog_origin: External benchmark allowed because Botswana public hourly load data are missing

name: WRI Global Power Plant Database – Botswana rows
limits: Database is no longer actively maintained. Current Stats Botswana/BPC figures override it.
catalog_origin: OIC2: OpenInfraMap & Global Power Plant Database

name: BPC T&D/system-loss history 2015–2024
limits: Combined T&D/system-loss accounting includes more than transmission I²R loss; transmission-model results are a diagnostic bracket, not directly equivalent.
catalog_origin: External official anchor required by GridIQ problem/solutions reports

name: BPC public transmission-grid and reliability context
limits: Headline grid/fleet statistics only; not branch ratings, impedances, switching state, line loading or per-asset condition.

name: Rural electrification status + verified six-village off-grid pilot
source: Ministry of Minerals & Energy / BPC / Census
limits: Public sources do not expose a verified current exhaustive list of every still-unconnected village; this release does not fabricate one.

name: SAPP BPC–Eskom transfer-limit snapshot
limits: Path entries are not summed as simultaneously available national import capacity without a network-path proof.

name: Agricultural Census 2025 livestock headline totals
limits: National totals are not allocated to villages. Local biomass/biogas ranking remains unavailable without local feedstock evidence.

name: IRENA renewable generation + BESS cost benchmarks
limits: Global technology benchmarks, not Botswana procurement quotes. Finance rate is a user-adjustable model assumption.

name: Rural grid-extension cost sensitivity
limits: Generic/project benchmarks, not BPC quotes; straight-line OSM distance is not an engineered route.
catalog_origin: External benchmark required because Botswana unit costs are not public

name: Botswana Global Electrification Platform (GEP)
limits: GEP is modelled planning data, not observed BPC load or grid state. Settlement-cluster download may require portal login.

name: Botswana Distributed Renewable Energy (DRE) Atlas settlements
ui_use: Settlement search, population/buildings, grid-distance/accessibility and PV/agriculture context
limitations: Not a verified BPC current unconnected-village register; modelled/derived settlement indicators.

name: Agricultural Census 2015 district cattle counts
limitations: Historical and district-level; never allocated to a village without local evidence.

name: FAO cattle-manure biogas yield benchmarks
ui_use: Quantify biogas volume only when explicit collectable manure mass is supplied
limitations: Not Botswana measured digester performance; collectable fraction is not inferred.

name: Eskom metering-based hourly system demand benchmark
used_for: normalized 24-hour demand shape for Botswana benchmark chronology
limits: South African hourly demand shape only. GridIQ discards the source MW magnitude and calibrates the normalized shape to Botswana published peak/annual-energy anchors; not measured Botswana demand.
catalog_origin: Regional benchmark used because public Botswana hourly load data are unavailable

name: PyPSA-Earth GEGIS / DemandCast hourly demand methodology
limits: Modelled/synthetic-global demand methodology, not Botswana metering. Used as benchmark methodology/fallback reference only.
catalog_origin: External benchmark methodology for chronological demand when BPC metering is unavailable

name: Botswana open administrative GeoJSON benchmark geometry
source: Location Grid Project public GIS layers
used_for: spatial joins when official Statistics Botswana polygons are unavailable
limits: Non-authoritative substitute. Must never be relabelled as Statistics Botswana official boundary geometry.
catalog_origin: Open geometry substitute used only while authoritative Botswana polygons are unavailable
